data.title: conductr-pod missing port trait
data.body: `crates/conductr-pod/src/lib.rs:42` calls `gh_cli.list_open_prs` directly; per hex rule #2 the use-case crate must go through a port trait. Suggested fix: introduce `ScmRead` port in conductr-core::ports and inject the adapter.

data.title: coverage: 14 uncovered lines in conductr-schedule pattern parser
data.body: Module `pattern.rs` has 14 uncovered lines (cov 71%, threshold 85%). Bulk of misses are error-path branches in `parse_repeat`.

data.title: security: daemon HTTP endpoint lacks authentication
data.body: `crates/conductr-daemon/src/http.rs` binds on `0.0.0.0:7890` without any auth middleware. Local-network peers can read full dashboard state without credentials.
